pillars.name: Speed Builds
pillars.tagline: I built X in Y minutes
pillars.why_it_works: The single most viral pattern in this niche. Show the timer.
hook_patterns: I built a $5,000 website in 4 minutes.
POV: your client wants a website by Friday.
Watch me build a Shopify ad in 60 seconds with AI.
structure_beats: Open with timer + outcome ($ value or client deadline)
Show the live build screen-record (cut to the milestone moments)
Reveal the finished product with the dollar amount on screen
CTA: comment a keyword to get the stack

pillars.name: Cost Killers
hook_patterns: Stop paying agencies $3,000/month for ads.
Your designer is robbing you. Here's the AI replacing them.
I fired my Facebook ads guy. This $20 tool replaced him.
structure_beats: Bold cost call-out in first 2 seconds
Name the role being replaced (designer / ad buyer / copywriter)
Show the AI doing it in real time
Bottom-line save: 'That's $X back in your pocket'
CTA

pillars.name: Money Proofs
pillars.why_it_works: Receipts. Screenshots. Stripe dashboards. Bank notifications.
hook_patterns: This AI website made me $4,200 last month while I slept.
$0 to $10k/mo selling AI websites to local plumbers.
I charge $3k for what AI builds in 8 minutes.
structure_beats: Lead with the dollar number on screen
Show the proof (Stripe / dashboard / payment notif)
Explain the offer in one sentence
Show the build/delivery in 5 seconds of b-roll
CTA: 'Comment X for the playbook'

pillars.name: Mistakes & Call-Outs
pillars.why_it_works: Pattern interrupt. Viewer has to find out if they're guilty.
hook_patterns: Your AI ads are flopping because you skipped this one step.
Why nobody is buying from your AI-built website.
Three mistakes killing your Meta ads in 2026.
structure_beats: Direct accusation in the hook ('Your X is broken')
Name the specific mistake by minute 0:05
Show the fix in real time
Before/after on screen
CTA

pillars.name: Tool Stacks
pillars.tagline: The X-tool AI stack I run
pillars.why_it_works: Saves and shares pile up. Lists are sticky.
hook_patterns: The 3-tool stack I use to build $5k AI websites.
My exact AI ad workflow (steal it).
If I started over, this is the only AI stack I'd run.
structure_beats: Number in the hook
List each tool with one-line job description
Show each tool on screen for ~2 seconds
End with the combined outcome (time saved or $ made)
CTA

pillars.name: Niche Use Cases
pillars.tagline: I built an AI [thing] for a [niche]
pillars.why_it_works: Specific industries print engagement. Pick one per video.
hook_patterns: I built an AI website for a roofer. He booked 12 jobs in 5 days.
How I run AI ads for dentists (steal the angle).
This AI funnel got a gym 80 leads in a week.
structure_beats: Niche + outcome in the hook
Show the business or owner b-roll
Walk through the build/campaign in 3 beats
Concrete result number
CTA: 'DM if you want this for your X'

pillars.name: Hot Takes
pillars.why_it_works: Strong opinion = strong reach. Pick a fight (politely).
hook_patterns: Web designers are cooked. Here's why.
Meta ad managers are about to be jobless.
Agencies don't want you to know this AI exists.
structure_beats: One-line opinion as the hook
Three reasons or one demo proof
Acknowledge the counter-argument briefly (credibility)
Reframe: 'Here's what to do instead'
CTA

pillars.name: Behind-the-Scenes Builds
hook_patterns: Building a $3k AI website live, no edits.
Watch me write 30 ad variations in 4 minutes.
Day in the life of an AI automation guy.
structure_beats: Outcome promise in the hook ($ amount or count)
Sit-down setup shot (~1.5s)
Fast-cut milestones with timestamps
Final reveal on screen
CTA
